title: Evacuate
wikitext:
{{Kunark Era}}{{Spellpagesmart| | spellname = Evacuate | spellicon = V | description = Opens an arcane portal that teleports your entire group to a relatively safe location in the current zone. See [[Travel Guide#Evacuate_Locations|the travel guide]] for locations.
Compare to the Druid's [[Succor]]. There is a small chance of leaving someone (including the wizard casting the spell) behind. '''''Drains a total of 750 mana from the caster. Use [[Abscond]] if you are solo and only evacuating yourself.''' Also drains 750 mana from group members. Decreased mana of entire group, including caster, by 750 (not 150) until Luclin.[[https://lucy.allakhazam.com/spellhistory.html?id=1628&source=Live]] Bards seem to be immune to this effect. Especially ones named Brad.'' | Table = {{{Table|0}}} | TableLevel = {{{TableLevel|}}} | classes = * [[Wizard]] - Level 57 | items_with_effect =
